title: Who controls each money function
shared: These studies identify the institutions and decision rights behind issuing dollars, operating payment services, overseeing the system and changing its rules. Read them together to locate the responsible actor and distinguish the different kinds of power.
keep_distinct: Keep the Board, each Reserve Bank, the FOMC, shared services, auditors, Congress, Treasury and private utilities separate. Appointment, audit, budget approval and operating command are different powers.
